title: eurylepis glabra
intro: Eurylepis glabra, commonly known as Smooth Wood Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Eurylepis glabra are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin irritations.
